scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 56 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2383 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Simplon Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: 125 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

grand-tour-of-switzerland-zurich-tasch-f.story: From Zürich it runs 828 km to Zermatt; allow about 12 h 23 of riding. It goes by way of Rhine Falls, St Gallen, Appenzell and Davos. The highest point is about 2,650 m. Fluela Pass and Furka Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

places-abrigo-de-la-fuente-del-sapo-rio-.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-abrigo-de-la-fuente-del-sapo-rio-.story: From Nerpio it runs 67 km to Nerpio; allow about 1 h 09 of riding. It goes by way of Abrigo de las Cañadas I, Río frío and back through Abrigo de las Cañadas I. The highest point is about 1,450 m. The line favours views over speed.
